svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of document upload and indexing. The control plane asks the tenant’s docs signer for a 60-second upload authorization, a presigned POST on AWS or a user-delegation SAS on Azure, records the document as pending, and the browser uploads the file straight to storage, then confirms. A delete goes through the signer, which removes the object itself. Either way the control plane then calls the backend’s public /api/index, which re-reads every object, chunks, embeds and upserts each document, and purges vectors of removed ones. Storage triggers nothing.
